question: Why must this teaching be kept secret by divine command?
premises: It is compared to the self-born origin.
The secrecy is enjoined by command.
inference: This teaching must be guarded in secrecy by command, like the self-born origin.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ātma+yoniḥ in this context is ambiguous.
plain_english: O Goddess, as with the self-born, so this must be kept secret by my command.
